  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, ChoiceBisim.choice h, ?_⟩

    · intro s' ht

        obtain ⟨p', ht', hb⟩ := h.follow_snd ht
        exact ⟨p', Tr.choiceL ht', ChoiceBisim.bisim hb⟩
      | choiceR ht =>
        exact ⟨s', Tr.choiceR ht, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  | bisim h =>
    constructor
    · intro s' ht
      obtain ⟨q', ht', hb⟩ := h.follow_fst ht
      exact ⟨q', ht', ChoiceBisim.bisim hb⟩
    · intro s' ht

      exact ⟨p', ht', ChoiceBisim.bisim hb⟩

      exact ⟨t, by solve_by_elim only [ht, Tr.choiceL], ChoiceBisim.bisim hb⟩

theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  rewrite [HomBisimilarity.symm_simulation]
  refine ⟨_, ChoiceBisim.choice h, ⟨?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro s1 s2 hr
    cases hr <;> constructor <;> symm <;> assumption
  · intro s1 s2 hr μ s' ht
    rcases hr with h | h
    case' choice => rcases ht with ht | ht
    case choice.choiceR =>
      exact ⟨s', Tr.choiceR ht, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    all_goals
      exact (h.follow_fst ht).imp fun _ hb =>
        ⟨by solve_by_elim only [hb.1, Tr.choiceL], ChoiceBisim.bisim hb.2⟩

  · intro s1 s2 hr

    all_goals

    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h

  · intro s1 s2 hr
    cases hr <;> constructor <;> symm <;> assumption
  · intro s1 s2 hr μ s' ht
    cases hr <;> rename_i h

    case choice.choiceR =>
      exact ⟨s', Tr.choiceR ht, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    all_goals
      exact (h.follow_fst ht).imp fun _ =>
        And.imp (by solve_by_elim [Tr.choiceL]) ChoiceBisim.bisim

theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  rewrite [HomBisimilarity.symm_simulation]
  refine ⟨_, ChoiceBisim.choice h, ⟨?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro s1 s2 hr
    cases hr <;> constructor <;> symm <;> assumption
  · intro s1 s2 hr μ s' ht
    cases hr <;> rename_i h
    case' choice => cases ht <;> rename_i ht
    all_goals first
      | exact ⟨s', Tr.choiceR ht, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
      | exact (h.follow_fst ht).imp fun _ =>
          And.imp (by first | exact id | exact Tr.choiceL) ChoiceBisim.bisim
